user.title: Vehicle Panel
user.description: Adds the Vehicles panel to the sidebar: range, trips, consumption, fuel prices, maintenance and lease of your cars. The lease contract of each car is set in the panel's Settings tab.

data_description.vehicles: The cars to show: any device with a device tracker (Renault, Tesla, Volvo, Stellantis…)
data_description.fuel_entities: Stations of the Carburants France integration (optional)
data_description.low_range: Below this range, the car is flagged in amber
